title: A Vision Transformer for ECG-Based Detection of Left Ventricular Systolic Dysfunction Across Multiple Clinical Sites
abstract: arXiv:2608.14723v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reduced left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is frequently asymptomatic and often detected only after advanced heart failure develops. Electrocardiograms are recorded routinely yet underused for this condition, because reduced LVEF has no single diagnostic waveform. We trained an ensemble of vision transformers from scratch to detect reduced LVEF ($\leq$40%) from 12-lead ECGs, analyzing each heartbeat individually, using 10,142 patients across seven sites in three US health systems. translated_title: 基于视觉Transformer的多中心心电图检测左心室收缩功能障碍
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.14723v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：左心室射血分数（LVEF）降低常常无症状，往往在晚期心力衰竭发展后才被发现。心电图虽常规记录，但对此状况利用不足，因为LVEF降低没有单一诊断波形。我们从零开始训练了一个视觉Transformer集成模型，用于从12导联心电图中检测LVEF降低（≤40%），逐心跳分析，使用了来自美国三个医疗系统七个地点的10,142名患者。在一个由美国三个地理独立临床地点组成的、真实世界LVEF降低患病率为8.72%的4,092名患者外部保留队列中，模型实现了AUROC为0.88（95% CI 0.86-0.89），敏感性为81.2%，特异性为81.0%，阴性预测值为97.8%。敏感性在性别、种族、民族和合并症亚组中保持较高，而特异性在老年患者及患有心房颤动或心脏病的患者中较低。
tldr: 本文首次从零训练视觉Transformer集成模型，利用12导联心电图逐心跳分析，在跨多中心外部队列中实现了高灵敏度和阴性预测值，有效检测左心室收缩功能障碍。
en_tdlr: This paper pioneers training vision transformer ensembles from scratch to detect left ventricular systolic dysfunction via 12-lead ECGs, achieving high sensitivity and negative predictive value across multi-center external cohorts.
